source.title: State Action Plan for Climate Change for the State of Goa

topics.title: Water, flooding & coasts
topics.summary: Find the proposals for water security, sewage, flooding and saltwater entering coastal areas.

actions.title: Make water infrastructure ready for climate risks
actions.description: Assess water facilities and build climate checks into new projects.
actions.agencies: Water Resources Department and Climate Secretariat

actions.title: Prepare low-lying neighbourhoods for flooding
actions.description: Assess vulnerable areas and plan protection for khazan lands and coastal settlements.
actions.agencies: Town and Country Planning, Water Resources and disaster management agencies; see individual rows

topics.question: Has our water supply, drainage or flood-protection project been assessed against the climate risks in the SAPCC?

topics.title: Farming, fishing & livestock
topics.summary: Explore crop, fisheries and livestock measures, including weather information and support for khazan livelihoods.

actions.title: Improve local weather information for farming
actions.description: Strengthen weather data collection, analysis and prediction with research and water agencies.
actions.agencies: ICAR, Water Resources Department and agencies such as IMD

actions.title: Prepare livestock for heat and flooding
actions.description: Plan livestock evacuation and heat relief in cattle sheds.
actions.agencies: Disaster management cell and Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services

topics.question: Which climate-related farm and livestock measures are being delivered in our village, and who can provide the current eligibility and progress records?

topics.title: Heat & health
topics.summary: Read the plan’s proposals for heat preparedness, disease alerts and more resilient health services.

actions.title: Prepare for extreme heat
actions.description: The plan proposes a heatwave action plan, with support from climate specialists.
actions.agencies: PHE and the Climate Secretariat, as named in the plan

actions.title: Give communities earlier disease information
actions.description: Develop public alerts and prediction systems for disease outbreaks.
actions.agencies: PHE, with IT, media and Goa Medical College support identified in the table

topics.question: Where can residents find the current heat action plan and official local health alerts?
topics.note: This is the health chapter of the statewide SAPCC. Goa’s separate State Action Plan on Climate Change and Human Health is a different document. These summaries are planning information, not medical advice.

topics.title: Waste & sanitation
topics.summary: Find waste-treatment proposals, village material recovery and plans for sewage systems.

actions.title: Recover materials closer to home
actions.description: The plan proposes a village-level material recovery facility where land is available.
actions.agencies: Panchayat Raj Department

actions.title: Check the plans for waste-treatment facilities
actions.description: Use the project tables to identify proposed facilities, funding and the status recorded when the document was prepared.
actions.agencies: Goa Waste Management Corporation and agencies listed for each project

topics.question: What is the current collection and segregation plan for our village, and which proposed facilities now have approvals and operating records?

topics.title: Getting around
topics.summary: See proposals for public transport, walking, cycling and lower-emission vehicles.

actions.title: Connect public transport with walking and cycling
actions.description: Provide non-motorised travel options and connected public transport for complete journeys.
actions.agencies: Transport Department; responsibility for some linked actions is still marked to be determined in the plan

actions.title: Plan for cleaner transport
actions.description: Develop electric mobility and a broader low-emission transport policy.
actions.agencies: Transport Department

topics.question: How do local transport plans connect buses, safe walking and cycling, and which SAPCC measures have been funded?

topics.title: Energy & solar power
topics.summary: Find renewable-energy proposals, energy-saving measures and skills development.

actions.title: Find the renewable-energy measures
actions.description: Browse the supply-side table for the plan’s renewable-energy interventions and agencies.
actions.agencies: Goa Energy Development Agency and Electricity Department; see each row

actions.title: Build skills for cleaner energy
actions.description: Train people to install and maintain renewable-energy systems and carry out energy audits.
actions.agencies: Goa Energy Development Agency

topics.question: Which energy-saving or solar programmes are currently available, and where are their official eligibility rules?

topics.title: Homes, villages & towns
topics.summary: Explore flood preparedness, more resilient housing and the capacity of villages to support development.

actions.title: Include village capacity in development decisions
actions.description: The plan proposes considering how much development each village can support.
actions.agencies: Panchayat Raj Department

actions.title: Plan housing for a changing climate
actions.description: Develop affordable, climate-resilient homes using green-building concepts.
actions.agencies: Rural Development Agency, Town and Country Planning and local bodies

topics.question: How does our village or town’s development plan account for water, waste, flooding and the people most exposed to climate risks?

topics.title: Forests, wildlife & mangroves
topics.summary: Look up measures for healthier forests, coastal vegetation and forest-fire preparedness.

actions.title: Restore natural coastal protection
actions.description: Restore damaged mangrove areas and strengthen coastal vegetation, including community livelihood support.
actions.agencies: Goa Forest Department

actions.title: Improve forest-fire preparedness
actions.description: Combine fire planning, staff training, equipment and community awareness before the fire season.
actions.agencies: Goa Forest Department

topics.question: What forest-fire preparation and habitat-restoration work is planned locally, and how can residents participate through the responsible department?

topics.title: Tourism & local livelihoods
topics.summary: Find the plan’s approach to community tourism and climate risks to tourism infrastructure.

actions.title: Explore community-based tourism
actions.description: The plan includes village and agro-tourism involving residents, self-help groups and panchayats.
actions.agencies: Agriculture Department and Tourism Department

actions.title: Assess risks to tourism infrastructure
actions.description: Include climate vulnerability and disaster preparedness when planning tourism facilities.
actions.agencies: Tourism Department, with related planning and disaster agencies

topics.question: How are residents involved in tourism plans, and what water, waste and climate-risk assessments are available for proposed projects?

topics.title: Mining & water resources
topics.summary: Read the measures addressing groundwater, mining audits and reducing pressure on sand resources.

actions.title: Understand groundwater around mining areas
actions.description: The plan proposes a comprehensive hydrogeological study.
actions.agencies: Water Resources Department

actions.title: Review mining compliance
actions.description: Use independent audits to check environmental assessment and clearance requirements.
actions.agencies: Climate Secretariat or other institutes, as named in the plan

topics.question: Are recent groundwater studies and environmental-compliance audit reports available for mining activity affecting our area?

topics.title: Understand the risks in Goa
topics.summary: Find observed climate trends, future scenarios and assessments of vulnerable places and communities.

actions.title: Start with the climate evidence
actions.description: Read the observations, model assumptions and future scenarios together. A projection is conditional on its scenario.
actions.agencies: Climate research sources cited in Chapter 4

actions.title: Look at who needs extra support
actions.description: The vulnerability chapter discusses low-lying communities and people whose circumstances increase their exposure.
actions.agencies: Planning and implementation agencies discussed in Chapters 5 and 7

topics.question: Which up-to-date local assessments support the risk information being used for our village or neighbourhood?
topics.note: The maps support state-level planning. They do not establish the risk, boundary or permission status of an individual plot. Read the map legend, scenario and limitations in the original PDF.

topics.title: Funding & progress
topics.summary: Understand the proposed financing and how the plan says implementation should be reviewed.

actions.title: Separate budget estimates from actual spending
actions.description: The plan discusses state funding and other financing routes. Its estimates do not establish amounts sanctioned or spent.
actions.agencies: State departments and climate coordination bodies

actions.title: Ask for implementation reports
actions.description: The plan proposes quarterly coordination and annual reporting before budget preparation, with sector indicators.
actions.agencies: Climate Secretariat, department representatives and State Level Steering Committee

topics.question: Can the responsible department share the latest SAPCC progress report, sanctioned budget, expenditure and results for this action?
topics.note: The source contains conflicting totals: printed p. 162 mentions ₹465 crore, while p. 163 and its budget table give ₹2,341.06 crore over ten years. Neither figure is verified current expenditure. The plan also retains older timeline references; do not calculate present-day deadlines from them.

topics.title: Have a say & follow up
topics.summary: Find the plan’s ideas for public participation, local awareness and coordination between departments.

actions.title: Bring climate questions into community discussions
actions.description: The plan proposes school learning, youth involvement and community task forces.
actions.agencies: Climate Secretariat with communities and institutions

actions.title: Find the coordinating responsibilities
actions.description: Each department is to nominate a climate officer, while the secretariat supports knowledge, coordination and monitoring.
actions.agencies: Department nodal officers and Climate Secretariat

topics.question: Who is the current climate nodal officer for this department, and where can residents access updates or contribute local evidence?
